intent_contract.text: Show treeline as a transition zone: closed forest opens into shorter wider-spaced trees and krummholz before treeless alpine vegetation. A hard graphic line, isolated bonsai or snowy peak alone is insufficient.

anti_patterns: centered beauty headshot pasted over a scenic background
separate studio face light that ignores the location's light direction
props listed as labels without contact shadow, reflection, weight, or physical interaction
a visible effect shell or flat image-plane slice that ignores local material identity, depth, and occlusion
beautiful subject in a detailed environment with no stake, contradiction, or visual relationship
manufactured sadness, rain-window melancholy, or generic longing used as a substitute for a specific visual proposition
symbolic props listed as labels without changing behavior, light, framing, or object relationships
metacritical labels such as visual argument or unresolved tension used instead of visible action, placement, light, or material evidence

concept_gates.check: 폐쇄 수관림·왜소목·크룸홀츠·무수목 지대가 완만한 상향 구배로 이어지는가

negative_en: 3D render look, fake-looking background, unwanted caption text, over-processed retouching, illustration look, cartoon style, low resolution, excessive HDR
